name: Rel-Time Protocol
description: Reviews the Rel-Time zero-knowledge VDF and Bitcoin timestamping tools that spend hash credits or write proof artifacts to disk: reltime_anchor, reltime_anchor_file, reltime_anchor_directory and reltime_download_certificate. Local SHA-256 hashing, Bitcoin ledger verification, account status and bit-for-bit forensic integrity audits keep Guard's usual handling. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: All file hashing in reltime_hash_file, reltime_anchor_file, reltime_audit_file and reltime_audit_folder runs locally via SHA-256; raw file contents never leave the machine.
Use reltime_get_status, reltime_verify_hash, reltime_audit_file and reltime_audit_folder to inspect credit balance and verify ledger proofs before anchoring new batches.
